PathOfBuilding.Notes:
**************************** ^x70FF70Pros^7 / ^xE05030Cons^7 of Build ************************************
^x70FF70Pros^7: Gets quite tanky due to life scaling + max res from ascendancy (and eventually can be build for suppress with really good gear, check dans pob for example) Smooth Playstyle(low button use, with pseudo cold rf feel) -> vaal cold snap you use roughly every 8 seconds Can get feels good fast without mageblood -> perma onslaught/adrenaline possible
^xE05030Cons^7: Dot Builds have limited scaling for DPS, late game damage will fall off on very high end farms -> delirious + really bad tank mods Late game wants corrupted items which can get very expensive with rare pieces. Can't really play the build well until cruel lab / vaal corrupted cold snap (early game should be very smooth with abberaths but it requires a mid leveling swap)
**************************** ^xFFFF77Vaal Cold Snap Concept^7 ***********************************
^x70FF70Shepherd of Souls^7 -> 80% less cost of vaal skills / 100% increased cost of souls for 8 Seconds ~ if our vaal cold snap^x70FF70 lasts longer than 8 seconds^7, we never incur the downside and thus this gives us^x70FF70 5x the amount of vaal casts^7
^x70FF7050% reduced soul costs^7 ascendancy node + ^x70FF7050% vaal skill duration^7, this makes our ^x70FF705x casts go to 8^7 (would be 10 but the game rounds up 3.5 soul cost to 4)
^x70FF70^x70FF70^7Small nodes^7^7^7 give ^x70FF70^710% additional vaal soul ^7^7so^x70FF70 40% chance to grant additional souls^7 on monster kill
^x70FF70Playstyle^7 -> start map -> kill 25 total monsters -> get capped 35 vaal souls
Proceed to chain ^x70FF708 vaal cold snaps ^7back to back for ^x70FF7060+ seconds ^7-> kill 25 monsters go again OR use soul ripper to go instantly back to full.
There will be a ^x70FF703-4 second downtime^7 for soul gain prevention at the ^x70FF70end of each 8 vaal cold snap chains^7, this will result in roughly 4 second down time for ^x70FF70every 65ish seconds ^7of gameplay 7.5% of the time roughly.
************************** ^xFFFF77Build Progression^7 ***********************************
Recommended: Level as ^x7070FFmagma orb ^7-> ^x7070FFfirestorm^7 classic fire caster leveling (^x7070FFcombustion ^7/^x7070FF eleprolife ^7/^xE05030 cruelty^7 / ^x7070FFflammability^7 / ^x7070FFwave of conviction^7 / ^x7070FFtempest shield ^7+ ^x70FF70arctic armour^7)
^x70FF70At normal Lab you have two options^7: Tryhard/speedge -> Spec lvl 20 abberaths hoooves (I can't see a world where this isn't busted damage at low level) Cold snap right away -> Click shepherd of souls node and start playing vaal cold snap right away paired with wintertide/creeping frost, this is going to be on the weaker side of leveling but itll be viable(change tree accordingly)
~^x70FF70Proceed to level to around lvl 60^7 / ^x70FF70cruel lab ^7at which point I believe you^x70FF70 can^7 ^x70FF70swap^7(technically if leveling is going well you can stall till merc lab too) to vaal cold snap with very consistent uptime with the combination of Duration node & shepher of souls
~^x70FF70From 60 onwards^7 each level buy heist ^x70FF70demolition^7('?' sidechests give chaos) & ^x70FF70lockpicking^7(currency side chests) contracts from the vendor, each level this vendor resets. Use this currency to buy some early recommended upgrades ( rares / vaal gloves / kaoms / rime gaze)
~^x70FF70Complete Campaign^7 enter maps and progress/currency farm based on your own preferences upgrading basic rares ect. until around level 90+ where I would recommend saving up currency for a rathpith tree swap with regen tattoos. Do ^xE05030NOT ^7swap until you have rathpith, that tree doesn't work without that shield.
~^x70FF70With life gearing^7 setup this should be able to run t17s/ubers with some difficulty/depending on mods and you can ^x70FF70farm currency^7 for putting together a ^x70FF70setup like uber dans^7.
